description: Get the settings of a policy that AI agents can change: for each one its id, label, group, current value, allowed values and whether changing it is high impact; plus the policy's version (the portal's number; every save raises it) and changedAt (when it was last saved), deviceCount and apps (package name, name, source, install type). Values: NOT_SET means left to the device or Google's default, CUSTOM a portal value these values cannot express. Read this before proposing changes with propose_policy_change with settings, propose_policy_change with apps or create_policy. Everything else in a policy is read with get_policy_document.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

policyId.description: The policy's path name - the unique identifier returned by list_policies as "pathName".

name: get_policy_settings
title: Get policy settings
